name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.7: install.sh now clears its own install lock on exit and retrieve.py treats .installed as authoritative (lock state can be stale due to PID re-use); wait notice shows the last few install.log lines so users without a side terminal can see actual progress. v0.2.6 extracted daemon_client.py shared by /add /list /remove. v0.2.5 dedup default OFF + retrieved-vs-used self-report. v0.2.4 daemon lazy-spawn for /add. v0.2.0–0.2.3 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
